ftm.office_official: Register of Wills for Montgomery County
ftm.office_address: 50 Maryland Avenue North Tower 3220, Rockville, Maryland 20850
ftm.notes: Online estate search available statewide via https://registers.maryland.gov/main/search.html. Contact the New Proceedings Division for opening new estates. Records Division handles copy requests (240-777-9680). Live chat available 8:30 am - 4:30 pm M-F. Documents no larger than 25 pages can be emailed in PDF format.

ftm.data_type: Foreclosure (first public signal for this state's process)
ftm.office_official: Circuit Court Land Records Public Information Room
ftm.office_address: North Tower, Second Floor, Room 2120, Rockville, Maryland
ftm.notes: Foreclosures can be judicial (Circuit Court) or nonjudicial (Recorder-filed notice). Search for lis pendens and trustee sale filings. MDLandRec (https://mdlandrec.net/) provides free online access to land records, including liens and judgments, after registration. Equity Index Books (1777-1981) are at Maryland State Archives online. Search by name, liber/folio, or tax account number. Copies available from Duplication Department (240-777-9480).

ftm.data_type: Recorder / Register of Deeds - Lien & Deed Index (mechanic's, tax, HOA, child-support liens; lis pendens)
ftm.office_official: Circuit Court Land Records Public Information Room
ftm.office_address: North Tower, Second Floor, Room 2120, Rockville, Maryland
ftm.notes: MDLandRec (https://mdlandrec.net/) provides free online access to land records, including liens and judgments, after registration. Search by name, liber/folio, or tax account number. Tax and child-support liens are indexed against the person, requiring name-matching to the assessor roll. Copies available from Duplication Department (240-777-9480).

ftm.office_official: Department of Finance, Division of Treasury
ftm.notes: Montgomery County conducts a public sealed bid tax lien sale annually. The sale is for tax liens, not the property itself. The owner retains title and can redeem. A notice of sale is mailed at least 30 days prior to advertisement. The County recommends seeking legal advice prior to participation. Specific list of properties for sale is published prior to the auction. No direct link to a current delinquent list found, but information on the sale process is detailed.

ftm.office_official: Department of Finance, Division of Treasury
ftm.notes: The county collects all unpaid and delinquent property taxes. While a specific 'pre-sale roll' URL isn't provided, the tax sale information page indicates that properties with unpaid taxes are subject to the annual tax sale. The list of properties for the tax sale would serve as the pre-sale roll. Contact the Department of Finance for access to the current delinquent roll prior to the annual sale.

ftm.office_official: e.g., City of Rockville Finance Department
ftm.notes: Montgomery County has several incorporated cities (e.g., Rockville, Gaithersburg, Takoma Park). Each city may levy its own property taxes and maintain separate delinquent lists. This would require individual research for each city. Start with the city's finance or treasurer department.

ftm.office_official: e.g., City of Rockville Code Enforcement
ftm.notes: Code violations are typically a city function. Many cities use Accela 'Citizen Access' portals. Research each incorporated city (e.g., Rockville, Gaithersburg, Takoma Park) for their specific code enforcement department and online portal. Look for an 'Export-to-Excel' option.

ftm.office_official: Montgomery County Department of Permitting Services (DPS) - Code Enforcement
ftm.notes: The Department of Permitting Services handles code enforcement for unincorporated areas. They have an online complaint system and a public records request process. An online portal for searching violations by address directly was not immediately apparent, suggesting records requests or 311 inquiries might be the primary method.

ftm.office_official: Montgomery County Department of Permitting Services (DPS) - Code Enforcement
ftm.notes: These types of violations would fall under the purview of Code Enforcement within the Department of Permitting Services. Specific lists of condemned or unsafe structures are usually not publicly indexed online but can be requested through public records. Inquire via MC311 or public records request.

ftm.office_official: Montgomery County Circuit Court Clerk / District Court Clerk
ftm.notes: Eviction (failure to pay rent, tenant holding over) cases are heard in the District Court of Maryland. Statewide Case Search (https://www.mdcourts.gov/casesearch) allows searching civil cases by party name. Search for plaintiffs (landlords) with multiple filings. While the Circuit Court handles some civil matters, District Court is the primary venue for evictions. No direct portal for 'multiple-eviction landlords' exists; this requires manual searching and analysis of court records.

ftm_narrative: Data gaps to know about: SiftMap data (provider data) is low or zero in Montgomery County, MD for: Foreclosure notices, Tax sale list, Tax delinquent roll. These are proven deal-makers nationally, and nobody can buy them here, so the county pulls below are not a backup, they are the only way in: treat them as priority pulls. Also not in SiftMap here: Eviction filings, Code violations, Divorce filings.
Sources pulled straight from the county the day records publish, 30 to 90 days before paid data. 'Verify locally' means confirm the link before you work it.

read_me.Doors/deal: Live list size divided by the deals that list produced in the window. Lower is better: fewer doors to work per closed deal.
read_me.Lift: County baseline doors/deal divided by the signal's doors/deal. 3.0 means three times sharper than pulling the whole county.
read_me.Baseline: The whole county unfiltered, counted the same way; the denominator every signal is judged against.
read_me.Stack: Records sitting on two distress lists at once. Stacks are distress plus distress; AI is never AND-stacked on distress.
read_me.AI score: DataSift Investor AI likelihood-to-sell score, 0-100, a PARALLEL pull alongside the distress lists.
read_me.score-gated: Live AI-scored supply counts are provisioned per account, so a local doors/deal cannot be computed in this view. The deals and coverage are this county's own data.
read_me.Verify supply: The row tripped the verify rule (v2.1 coverage-aware: verify reasons annotate (churn: doors/deal < 5; small: list < 250) without demoting; only judicial notice lists and churn artifacts (doors/deal < 1) force P3. Volume floors: P1 needs >=2% of county deal flow or >=25 deals, P2 >=1% or >=12 deals): demand is real, treat the efficiency as directional until you price the live list.
read_me.Evidence A / B / C: from this county's own sold deals / cross-market benchmark / single-market anchor (Knox + Blount TN AI measurement)
read_me.Typical gross: Median of AVM value minus purchase price on clean deals: acquisition spread, not net profit.
read_me.Non-disclosure states: Sale prices are not public there, so deal-dollar columns are omitted; doors/deal and lift never use dollars.
